answer: Market pricing beats policing: every unverified claim must clear an open auction before emission, and only third parties paying real value bid. A claim drawing no bid forces liquidation at a forty percent haircut into the harbor pool funding honest bidders. Copied work finds no buyers across the ocean of names, so each fake burns 6,000 POA plus a 15,000 POA bond forfeited from the settlement vault. A hundred clones torch 600,000 in haircuts.
